DECEMBER 1929----This month we must congratulate J.E. Flower upon winning the South of Thames Junior race.

We have no record of the race concerned except to know that J.E.FLOWER (right) was the winner. W.L.(Wally) BAYLISS, our then General Honorary Secretary, is the timekeeper, while W.H.(Harry) HARE, Past President and Honorary Treasurer, acts as recorder.
BELGRAVE H 113pts (A.W.Penny 4, H.E.Footer 9, A.E.Taylor 16, A.Allum 20, J.E.Flower 28, H.W.Shields 36). MARCH 31st 1934, THE INTER-COUNTIES CHAMPIONSHIP ........
